title: What Andy Reid told Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III 'that meant a lot to me' and how it's lifting KC

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What Andy Reid told Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III 'that meant a lot to me' and how it's lifting KC
sources.description: In his first year with Kansas City, Walker is leading the NFL in all major rushing categories. Teaming up with Reid and Patrick Mahomes helps, as does the Chiefs' demonstrated investment in him.
